name: Caledvwlch

attributes.attribute: variant spelling of the blade name Caledfwlch
Welsh name for the great sword of Arthur

text: Caledvwlch is a variant spelling of the name Caledfwlch. Caledfwlch is the Welsh name for the great sword of Arthur. The same blade travels across many traditions. Irish legend calls it Caladbolg. Later English romance knows the sword as Excalibur. Arthur carries this blade into battle. See the entry for Caledfwlch for the fuller account. This spelling merely offers an alternate form.

okr.objective: Point the reader to the fuller entry for the sword named Caledfwlch.
key_results: Record that Caledvwlch is a variant spelling.
Note the sword belongs to Arthur.
Reference the fuller names Excalibur and Caladbolg.
